body.name: recover-or-abstain certificate \(\mathsf C\)
body.construction: Use \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{sup}}\), the disjoint \(n\)-draw observational support batch, to recover its span; if that span has dimension below \(n\), return \(\bot\) without inversion. On \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{sup}}\), the span equals the deterministic support \(\mathcal S\), so apply the public canonical-frame rule to obtain exactly \(U\) and set \(Y_i^{(m)}=U^{\top}X_i^{(m)}\). Maintain one retained post-support stream in each environment. At stage \(r=0\), retain the first \(N_0=1\) observation from each stream; at every stage \(r\ge1\), append exactly \(N_r-N_{r-1}\) new observations, so the cumulative stream contains exactly \(N_r=2^r\) observations per environment. For \(r<r_0=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil\), sample and retain observations only; do not form an inverse or run any spectral or projector test. For \(r\ge r_0\), assign error \(\alpha\,2^{-r-1}\), form each \(S_{m,r}=N_r^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{N_r}Y_i^{(m)}Y_i^{(m)\top}\) from the same retained prefix, invert it in \(\mathbb R^n\), and compute \(\widehat R_{m,r}=(S_{0,r}^{-1}-S_{m,r}^{-1})S_{0,r}(S_{0,r}^{-1}-S_{m,r}^{-1})\). Enclose each primitive matrix within operator radius \(e_r=40\kappa^4a_r\). Restart \(\mathsf A\) from its initial state and accept a rank only when every Weyl interval selects exactly one of \(\{0\}\) and \([g_0,\infty)\); accept a projector comparison only when its propagated interval selects exactly one of \(\{0\}\) and \([h_0,1]\). Use the smallest certified-zero observed intervention label. Return the graph on those labels and, for each singleton range, map a certified coordinate unit vector \(v_m\in\operatorname{col}(R_m)\) to the ambient encoder row \(v_m^{\top}U^{\top}\); return only after the entire transcript is resolved. Otherwise report \(\bot\), retain all samples, and advance to the next doubling stage.
